description: This Java class 'BOMTree' models an in-memory bill of materials (BOM) for manufacturing, supporting tree traversal, explosion, implosion, and manufacturing order creation.

classes.name: BOMTree
classes.description: Represents an in-memory bill of materials (BOM) supporting tree traversal, explosion, implosion, and manufacturing order creation.

methods.name: BOMTree
methods.description: Constructs a BOMTree by reading downward or upward from a product, with options for explosion or implosion.

methods.name: getInputProduct
methods.description: Returns the input product associated with the BOMTree.

methods.name: manufacturedAsProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the product that the given product is manufactured as, based on product associations.

methods.name: hasBom
methods.description: Checks if a product has an associated bill of materials for a given date.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Determines if the BOMTree is fully configured, i.e., contains no virtual or unconfigured nodes.

methods.name: getRootQuantity
methods.description: Gets the quantity of the root product.

methods.name: setRootQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the root product.

methods.name: getRootAmount
methods.description: Gets the total amount associated with the root product.

methods.name: setRootAmount
methods.description: Sets the total amount for the root product.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root BOMNode of the tree.

methods.name: getInDate
methods.description: Returns the date associated with the BOMTree.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints the BOMTree structure into a StringBuffer for debugging.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints the BOMTree nodes into a list for breakdown purposes, with optional depth and WIP exclusion.

methods.name: sumQuantities
methods.description: Summarizes quantities of all products in the BOMTree into a map.

methods.name: getAllProductsId
methods.description: Returns a list of all product IDs contained in the BOMTree.

methods.name: createManufacturingOrders
methods.description: Creates manufacturing orders for nodes that need to be manufactured, based on the BOMTree.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Retrieves products contained in packages within the BOMTree.
